name: Steelgrill's Depot
summary: Steelgrill's Depot is a bustling engineering workshop and repair station situated directly east of Kharanos in Dun Morogh. Overseen by Belbi Steelgrill and a crew of craftsmen, it serves as a frontline hub for vehicle maintenance, tinker supply runs, and salvage efforts.

sections.title: A Bastion of Steam and Steel
sections.body: Nestled just off the snowy road east of Kharanos, Steelgrill's Depot buzzes with the clamor of clanking metal, hissing steam vents, and the hum of experimental engines. Dwarven miners and eccentric gnome engineers gather here amid heavy machinery, mechanized walking frames, and stockpiles of raw ores hauled out from nearby quarries. With Dun Morogh facing relentless trogg disruptions and mechanical supply shortages, Belbi Steelgrill and his crew keep Alliance machinery in working order, serving as an indispensable stop for travelers seeking spare parts or technical guidance in the bitter cold.

faq.answer: Steelgrill's Depot is an engineering workshop and outpost in Dun Morogh, located just down the road east of Kharanos. It caters to miners, tinkerers, and field technicians maintaining heavy machinery.
The depot is managed by the Steelgrill family, notably Belbi Steelgrill, alongside fellow dwarven and gnomish crafters who maintain the surrounding machinery and oversee mining operations.
The depot houses trade suppliers, repair services, and trainers for craftsmen looking to hone their engineering and gathering skills out in the field.

angles.text: The depot is an open-air laboratory surrounded by steam machinery and tinkering supplies, making it a natural rest stop for aspiring engineers traveling through Dun Morogh.
Working closely with their dwarven hosts, exiled gnomish tinkers often use the depot's forge fires and spare components to keep their salvaged contraptions running.
